description:
## Destination

A written CI design spec, ready to hand to an implementer: how toolbox CI determines which packages a change affects, builds only those, and interposes a manual gate when a change triggers a mass rebuild (nix-pins bumps) so the human can confirm the cache was pre-populated. The map ends at the spec — implementing the workflows is a follow-up effort.

## Notes

Domain: Nix flake package registry (79 packages, many versions each, 4 declared systems) + GitHub Actions.

Current state:
- `.github/workflows/cachix.yml` — on push to `main` only, single matrix entry `x86_64-linux`, builds `attrValues packages.<system>` ++ `attrValues devShells.<system>` in one `nix build`, pipes out-paths to `cachix push`.
- No PR-time build exists at all.
- `.github/workflows/docs.yml` — separate python/mdbook docs pipeline, unrelated to package builds.
- Cache: cachix `firefly-toolbox`, also advertised via `flake.nix` `nixConfig`.

Settled up front (from the charting grilling):
- Trusted-contributors repo — no fork PRs. PR jobs may hold the Cachix push token.
- The gate exists primarily to protect **CI time**: the human pre-populates the cache locally for `aarch64-darwin` and `x86_64-linux`, so CI should never grind through 79 packages itself.
- PR-time builds are in scope.

Skills: `/grilling`, `/domain-modeling`, `/research`, `forage-nix`.

Every session: read `CLAUDE.md` (package/registry model), then this map.

## Decisions so far

<!-- one line per closed ticket -->

## Not yet specified

- Whether `devShells` and the `docs.yml` pipeline fold into the same affected-set machinery or stay independent.
- Behaviour when the affected set is empty (docs-only or beadwork-only change) and how GitHub required status checks cope with a dynamic/empty matrix.
- Toolchain meta-packages (`symlinkJoin` bundles like `go-toolchain`, `nix-toolchain`): a component bump changes the toolchain derivation too. Depends on which affected-set mechanism wins.
- Who pushes to cachix and when — PR job, post-merge job, or both — and how to avoid double work when a PR-built path is already cached at merge time.
- Fixed per-job overhead (nix-installer + cachix-action setup) and whether runner sizing / self-hosted runners are worth revisiting.
- Rollout: branch-protection changes, and whether the current all-packages workflow runs in parallel during transition.

## Out of scope

- Adding `aarch64-darwin` / `aarch64-linux` / `x86_64-darwin` to the CI matrix. CI stays linux-only; darwin coverage remains the human’s local pre-population.
- Fork-PR / untrusted-contributor safety. Repo is trusted-contributors-only.
- Implementing and merging the workflows. The map ends at the spec.
title: Map: affected-only CI with a mass-rebuild gate
